activity.notes: Bagrat III had earlier ruled Abkhazia, but the unified Kingdom of Georgia is modeled from 1008, when he inherited his father's lands and became the first ruler of the combined Georgian monarchy. The Oxford Handbook's ruler table gives Bagrat III's Kingdom of Georgia reign as 1008–1014.

sources.title: Rulers — The Oxford Handbook of Byzantine Studies
sources.citation_text: The Oxford rulers table lists Bagrat III as king of Georgia from 1008 to 1014.

sources.title: Bagrat III — Georgian Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The Georgian Encyclopedia describes Bagrat III as the first king of united feudal Georgia and explains the 1008 inheritance that consolidated the Georgian monarchy.
